verdict.rationale: Kintsugi supports importing historical transactions via CSV upload or API sync covering the prior full calendar year, and explicitly determines nexus/exposure retroactively to identify when a filing obligation began and where a business owes tax. However, no evidence describes computing estimated penalties or interest per jurisdiction — only nexus determination and a forward-looking tax estimate endpoint are documented. Missing for 10: explicit penalty/interest calculation, a consolidated 'exposure report' output format, and independent/hands-on confirmation of backdated liability figures.
